description: Request hiring a freelancer from an OpenTrain proposal. This does NOT hire or move money: it records a pending approval and returns an approvalUrl a signed-in human must open and confirm in the OpenTrain app (expires in ~72h). The human confirms in the normal hiring interface and may adjust the milestone terms there. Watch opentrain_poll_updates for approval.confirmed or re-check with opentrain_get_approval — the confirmed result includes the new contractId. Requires proposals:write scope and the public_api_hiring feature. Agent accounts must be claimed by a human (403 with claimUrl), and the account needs a payment method or covering credit balance (409 with reason payment_method_required and a billingUrl a human must visit). A 409 with reason not_fit_confirmation_required means retry with confirmNotFitOverride=true if intentional. Re-requesting with identical terms returns the existing pending approval; changed terms supersede it. DEV-4500: the contract rate defaults to the applicant’s bid unless you pass rateUsd; the hire always executes at the bid and a different rateUsd is proposed to the worker when the human confirms (rate.status PENDING_WORKER_ACCEPTANCE) — a rate different from the bid needs the worker’s acceptance and is never written silently. milestone.hours (hourly proposals) funds hours × the bid with the hours recorded on the milestone; with both amount and hours a mismatch is rejected. The response always echoes rate (contractRateUsd, bidRateUsd, postedRateUsd, requestedRateUsd, status) and warnings, e.g. when the bid differs from the job’s posted rate.

confirmNotFitOverride.description: Set true to confirm hiring a proposal previously marked "Not a fit" after a 409 not_fit_confirmation_required response.

milestone.description: First escrow milestone for the new contract. Provide name and/or description, and amount or hours.

amount.description: First milestone amount in USD. Optional when hours is given (then hours × the bid). No money moves until a signed-in human confirms the hire approval.

description.description: Milestone description of the work to be delivered.

hours.description: DEV-4500: funded hours (hourly proposals only). The milestone amount is hours × the contract rate (the bid) and the hours are recorded on the milestone; with both amount and hours a mismatch is rejected.

proposalId.description: OpenTrain proposal/job offer id to hire from.

rateUsd.description: DEV-4500: requested contract rate (USD/hour). The contract rate defaults to the applicant’s bid unless you pass rateUsd; the hire always executes at the bid and a different rate is proposed to the worker when the human confirms (PENDING until the worker accepts) — a rate different from the bid needs the worker’s acceptance and is never written silently.

name: opentrain_hire_proposal
